factSources.text: With Uranus in Gemini, the urge to break from old patterns works through words, ideas, media, and daily connections. Conversations, news, and ways of learning become the places where the familiar gets disrupted. (Modern planet; no traditional dignity.)

factSources.text: Uranus describes awakening, disruption, freedom, invention, rupture, surprise, and the part of life that refuses to stay trapped inside a stale pattern. It shows where someone needs room to change and where the old structure may no longer fit. Uranus takes about eighty-four years to move through all twelve signs and spends about seven years in each sign. Its house transits mark longer chapters of change, liberation, instability, and new possibility. Implies an innovative mind with unique communication styles. Those with this placement may invent or create revolutionary ideas in media, technology, or education.
